description: SDPA forward over the prefill kernel of hipkernel:Gfx1151WmmaAttention (Gfx1151WmmaAttentionNative.cpp; the shipped catalog descriptors/rocKE/gfx1151_wmma_attention/gfx1151_wmma_attention.kdp.json), NOT RUN ON ANY DEVICE: no gfx1151 machine is part of this work, so the space is proven only by the pytest load, sample and render tests, and every claim below is what the code and the shipped descriptors say, not something observed. Half or bfloat16 (supportedDataTypeName; the catalog ships both for every row), BSHD or BHSD (isWellFormedOperand asks a head-dim stride of 1 and hasAlignedRows a multiple of 8 elements for every other stride of an extent above 1, which both layouts give for a head size that is a multiple of 8), grouped-query heads (Hq a multiple of Hkv), and the six (head_size, head_size_v) buckets the catalog ships for prefill: 64/64, 96/96, 128/128, 192/128, 256/128 and 256/256 (so V and O are narrower than Q and K for 192 and 256 over 128). Every row ships the three bias kinds none, f32 and q, and the mask class 'causal', whose runtime bounds also express no mask, so the four masks the space draws (none, top-left causal, bottom-right causal, a sliding window by left_bound/right_bound with either alignment) are all served by the same objects (maskModeServes). left_bound has cuDNN semantics (L keeps the L keys ending at the diagonal, diagonal included); maskFor passes window_left = L - 1 to the kernel. A head size of 100, 1 draw in 13, is the decline probe: isServedHeadDim needs a multiple of 8, so both Gfx1151 engines decline it. Query rows that would see no key (bottom-right causal or a window with seqlen_q above seqlen_kv or a window clear of the diagonal) are excluded as in SdpaBackward: the reference gives them a zero row and an LSE of -inf, which is not an input the kernel is described to define. stats (off, on) adds the FP32 log-sum-exp tensor [b, hq, sq, 1] (add_tensors, stride [hq*sq, sq, 1, 1], declaring the sampled alignment, which the matcher needs to be a multiple of 4 bytes: LSE_ALIGN_BYTES) and sets generate_stats and stats_tensor_uid (node_patches), the form the matcher takes (it declines a stats tensor without the flag and the reverse). bias (none, f32, q) adds the additive attention mask the references grade (attn_mask_tensor_uid through node_patches): dims [B or 1, Hq or 1, Sq or 1, Sk] chosen by the bcast_b, bcast_h and bcast_q axes, packed strides with a unit key stride, FP32 or the Q dtype (biasFor declines every other dtype, a rank below 4, a broadcast key axis and a declared alignment below the element size, 4 or 2); GpuSdpaFwdPlan.hpp and the CPU SdpaFwdPlan.hpp register a mask of float, half or bfloat16 for each of these Q types and add it to the scaled scores (the window or causal mask applies after), as the kernel's bias does. The tensors are named bias and stats because import_graph.py numbers tensors by sorted name and a freeze must keep their uids: bias is uid 4, stats is uid 5 with a bias and uid 4 without. The alignment axis declares one alignment on Q, K, V and O (tensor_patches on uids 1, 0, 3, 2) and the matcher needs 16 bytes from each (QKVO_ALIGN_BYTES), so alignments 1 to 8 decline whatever the shape; placement puts the pointers at exactly that alignment (exact) or misaligns Q (placement_uid 1) below it, which passes only if the backend rejects it (under, drawn as exact at alignment 1). PREFILL VERSUS DECODE: a graph that the rocKE dispatcher routes to decode (rdnaAttentionUseDecode, with the key range any row sees from decodeKvRange, on gfx11) is declined by this engine (catalogDecodePlan) and served by hipkernel:Gfx1151WmmaAttentionDecode, whose space is SdpaFwd/Gfx1151Decode. The rule depends on the device's compute-unit count (twice HIP's multiProcessorCount); the space draws only shapes that go to prefill at 40 compute units, which are prefill at 32 too, and [INFERENCE] those are the two Strix Halo sizes (8050S, 8060S); shapes the two counts route differently are in neither space. With seqlen_q at most 64 the gfx11 rule keeps decode unless seqlen_q * Hq/Hkv >= 512, the visible keys reach 64 * 40 and batch * visible keys reach 512 * 40, which a key length up to 2048 and a batch up to 4 never meet; so the space draws seqlen_q from 65, where it needs 4 * batch * Hq * ceil(seqlen_q / 128) >= 40. The domain axis fills Q, K and V as in the SdpaFwd spaces (large uses scale 8, V keeps free(-2,2) under wide and scale 2 under large, nan and inf go on V alone at 2^-12 of its elements, only where no mask applies and for an infinity only for bfloat16 with a scale at most 1): inherited from the gfx950 probes of the ASM and rocKE dense kernels, not measured on these kernels. The cost ceiling b*hq*sq*skv*dqk <= 2**31 is the one of the other SdpaFwd spaces (GPU reference cost ceiling, RFC 0023 section 14). The engine TOML (config/hipkernel_Gfx1151WmmaAttention.toml) carries no tolerance override: the default forward tolerances apply until a device run says otherwise.

derive.stride_q: [sq*hq*dq, dq, hq*dq, 1] if layout == 'bshd' else [hq*sq*dq, sq*dq, dq, 1]
derive.stride_k: [skv*hkv*dq, dq, hkv*dq, 1] if layout == 'bshd' else [hkv*skv*dq, skv*dq, dq, 1]
derive.stride_v: [skv*hkv*dv, dv, hkv*dv, 1] if layout == 'bshd' else [hkv*skv*dv, skv*dv, dv, 1]
derive.stride_o: [sq*hq*dv, dv, hq*dv, 1] if layout == 'bshd' else [hq*sq*dv, sq*dv, dv, 1]
derive.right: 0 if mask in ['causal_top_left', 'causal_bottom_right'] else (wr if mask == 'window' else None)
derive.rows_see_a_key: (right == None or diag + right >= 0) and (left == None or sq + diag - left <= skv - 1)
derive.kv_hi: max(min(ctx + right + sq, skv), 0) if (right != None and right >= 0) else skv
derive.decode_at_40: (4 * tiles < 40) if sq > 64 else (group * sq < 512 or visible < 64 * 40 or b * visible < 512 * 40)
derive.nf_ok: not masked and not (domain == 'inf' and (dtype == 'half' or scale > 1))
derive.dom_kind: 'fixed' if domain == 'constant' else ('special' if dom_poison else ('free' if domain in ['default', 'narrow', 'wide', 'positive', 'nan', 'inf'] else domain))
derive.dom_lo: -0.01 if domain == 'narrow' else (-8 if domain == 'wide' else (0.25 if domain == 'positive' else (0.5 if domain == 'constant' else -1)))
derive.dom_hi: 0.01 if domain == 'narrow' else (8 if domain == 'wide' else (4 if domain == 'positive' else (0.5 if domain == 'constant' else 1)))
derive.eff_placement: 'exact' if placement == 'under' and alignment < 2 else placement

constraints.reason: a query row with no key under the mask has a zero output row and an LSE of -inf in the references (CpuFpReferenceSdpa.hpp, 'fully masked rows'), which the kernel is not described to define; bottom-right causal needs sq <= skv, and a window must reach a key from every row

rdnaAttentionUseDecode (Gfx1151WmmaAttentionNative.cpp) routes such a shape to the decode engine, which the prefill engine declines (catalogDecodePlan): SdpaFwd/Gfx1151Decode draws it. The shapes the rule sends to prefill at 40 compute units are prefill at 32 too. A head size that is not a multiple of 8 is the decline probe and has no decode route
GPU reference cost ceiling (RFC 0023 section 14), as the other SdpaFwd spaces
